📖 How to use

  1. Paste the original text into the first box and the revised text into the second.
  2. Click "Compare texts".
  3. Added words are highlighted green, removed words red, unchanged words stay plain.
  4. Check the summary for the count of added, removed and unchanged words.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the diff computed?

Words are compared with the longest-common-subsequence algorithm, so matching words are aligned even when large blocks move around.

Why is there a 5,000-word limit per text?

The cap keeps the diff fast — a 5,000-word-per-side comparison already fills 25 million table cells in memory. Compare larger texts in smaller chunks.

Are my texts sent anywhere?

No. The diff runs entirely in your browser; your texts never leave your device.
